item.title: Trump orders federal agencies to halt use of Anthropic AI amid Pentagon dispute
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump has directed all federal agencies to stop using artificial intelligence tools developed by Anthropic, escalating a public standoff between the White House and the AI company over how its technology can be used by the military. In a post on Truth Social, Trump said the government would immediately cease using Anthropic’s technology and phase it out over six months. item.title: Vanita Keswani steps down as CEO of Madison Media Sigma
item.description: Vanita Keswani has stepped down as Chief Executive Officer of Madison Media Sigma, marking the end of a three-decade-long association with Madison World. item.title: Infectious Advertising wins the integrated mandate for BKT Tyres’ India business portfolio
item.description: Balkrishna Industries Limited (BKT), an Indian multinational tyre manufacturing company based in Mumbai, India, has appointed Infectious Advertising as its integrated creative and digital agency for India. The mandate (both mainline as well as digital) to Infectious spans BKT’s tyre business in India, covering both its established Off-Highway Tyres (OHT) portfolio as well as its newly launched On-Highway tyre range. item.title: Shrey Gandhi elevated to Deputy General Manager and Head of Social Media at Cheil India
item.description: Shrey Gandhi has been appointed Deputy General Manager and Head of Social Media at Cheil India. item.title: Ashish Khazanchi, Anisha Iyer, Sabyasachi Mitter named Chairpersons for AdClub Madras’ MADDYS 2026
item.description: Advertising Club Madras has announced the opening of submissions for the 44th edition of MADDYS 2026 from 2nd March 2026, with the final entry deadline set for 20th April 2026. item.title: UK seeks public consultation on under-16 social media ban
item.description: The UK government has launched a public consultation on whether to ban social media use for children under 16, inviting young people, parents and guardians to submit their views before a final decision is made, BBC reported. The debate has intensified following Australia’s move last year to bar children under 16 from several major platforms.
